fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: Sends a bite into the first enemy it meets that deals 11 poison damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles for 60% of that, and your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: End of the Tether
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. A lash at up to 6 tiles deals 9 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and wraps the target so it moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragging Loops
fusions.desc: Lays a line of loops 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Whispered Onward
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
